paragraph: Why do you want to **embrace** Islam? You need to **embrace** your role as a man. I wrap you in a warm and soft **embrace**.
english: to clasp (someone or each other) in the arms with affection
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تريد اعتناق الإسلام؟

other.meaning: An act of putting arms around someone and bringing the person close to the chest (noun)

paragraph: They spotted a blue **jay** flying.
english: any of various other birds of similar appearance and behaviour

paragraph: Free time is at a **premium** for working parents. How much does the **premium** membership cost? Does this car use regular or **premium**?
english: superior in quality

paragraph: They took enough **provisions** for three years at sea. They prepared **provisions** for us for the journey. The **provisions** ran out after a short time.
english: providing something; also a part of a law or agreement

paragraph: At the age of 70, he's still an **activist**. He is an **activist** in his community. I want to become an **activist**.
english: one who is politically active in the role of a citizen
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ناشطة

paragraph: You have to take the rough with the **smooth**. The first part of the ride was very **smooth**. The course of true love never did run **smooth**.
english: having a texture that lacks friction. Not rough
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أملس

paragraph: You should **distinguish** between right and wrong. What **distinguishes** Islam from other religions? It's not always easy to **distinguish** good from evil.
english: to see the difference between things
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي أن تميز بين الصحيح والخطأ.

paragraph: I told you this was going to be **boring**. Without music, the world would be a **boring** place. Hang out with people who are not **boring**.
english: causing boredom or tiredness
arabicDesc: مثال: قلت لك أن ذلك سيكون مملاً.

paragraph: Are you **confident** in who you are? What makes you so **confident**? She's **confident** in him, and that's all he needs.
english: being very sure of or positive about something
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك الثقة في نفسك؟

paragraph: Without **electricity** we can't live a good life today. There is no life without **electricity** and water. Artificial light is produced by **electricity**.
english: form of energy
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكن لنا أن نعيش حياة سعيدة بدون كهرباء في أيامنا هذه.

paragraph: This book will be **helpful** to your study. If you found this video **helpful**, please give it a like. The materials used are too different to be **helpful**.
english: furnishing help; giving aid; useful
arabicDesc: مثال: سيساعدك هذا الكتاب في دراستك.

paragraph: You can't see stars with the **naked** eye in a big city.
english: not wearing any clothes; also not covered
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عار

paragraph: Game theory is the study of **strategic** decision making. Some **strategic** panning helped his mixes sound fuller. Preparing for natural disasters requires **strategic** planning.
english: of or pertaining to strategy

paragraph: **Swimming** in the sea doesn't mean owning the sea. You must pay attention when **swimming** in the sea. Even if it rains, I'll go **swimming** tomorrow.
english: human activity of moving oneself through water
arabicDesc: مثال: السباحة في البحر لا تعني امتلاك البحر.

paragraph: I'm living on **welfare**, without a car or anything. We did everything for the **welfare** of our children. Is there someone who is familiar with **welfare** systems?
english: health, safety, happiness and prosperity
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خير

paragraph: Where did you find the **inspiration** for all this? **Inspiration** exists, but it has to find you working. They had good flashes of **inspiration** about this plan.
english: a single inward breath (intake of air)

paragraph: If you **alter** the plan, you must inform the team members of the changes. The section chief **altered** the plan. As the artist grows older his paintings may **alter**.
english: to change the form or structure of
arabicDesc: مثال: إذا قمت بتغيير الخطة، فيجب عليك أن تعلم أعضاء الفريق بالتغييرات.

paragraph: Your first draft should just be a brain **dump**. He was almost run over by a **dump** truck. Today three grand pianos appears at the municipal **dump**.
english: a place where waste or garbage is left
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نفاية، مكان إلقاء القمامة

paragraph: No one found any reason to **criticize** his actions. Nothing is as easy as to **criticize** others. You're in no position to **criticize** my morals.
english: to find fault (with something)

paragraph: I couldn't secure funding for the new business **venture**. Do not **venture** to come out of your homes. We are affiliated with the new joint **venture** company.
english: to undertake a risky or daring journey

paragraph: Everyone has the right to life, **liberty** and the security of person. You are at **liberty** to make use of this room in any way you please. Force is born in violence and dies with **liberty**.
english: condition of being free
arabicDesc: مثال: لكل فرد الحق في الحياة والحرية وسلامة شخصه.

paragraph: It is believed that he was a **brave** soldier. The **brave** man over there saved my life. **Brave** people feel fear, but that doesn't stop them.
english: strong in the face of fear
arabicDesc: مثال: يُعتقد أنه كان جنديا شجاعا.

paragraph: If you like it, I'll give you the **recipe**. This **recipe** has been in my family for 100 years. Would you mind giving me your chocolate cake **recipe**?
english: instructions for making or preparing food dishes

paragraph: They didn't **react** at all. They simply ignored us. The funny thing was that he did not **react**. She had never imagined he would **react** this way.
english: to act in response

paragraph: He **bowed** to the king. This blue **bow** tie doesn't go with the suit. Fall to your knees and **bow** before me, child.
english: to become bent
arabicDesc: مثال: انحنى للملك.

other.meaning: A gesture, usually showing respect, made by inclining the head or bending forward at the waist (noun)
The front of a boat or ship (noun)

paragraph: You need to use a pot **holder** when handling hot pots. He is the current title-**holder**. My uncle uses a cigarette **holder**.
english: a person who has something; also a container

paragraph: I often seek **input** from others before I choose. The **input** method also works with this version. I need your **input** on something extremely important.
english: the act or process of putting in

paragraph: Do you have to **yell**? The crowd **yelled** when he scored a goal. Why are you **yelling** like this?
english: to shout
arabicDesc: مثال: هل عليك أن تصيح؟

paragraph: She bought two pounds of **butter**. Pass me the **butter**, please. **Butter** is essential for baking.
english: soft foodstuff made from milk
arabicDesc: مثال: اشترت رطليْ زبدة.

paragraph: She **dived** into the swimming pool. His desire to **dive** has cost him his life. I think you need to deep-**dive** into this.
english: to jump into water head-first
arabicDesc: مثال: غطست في المسبح.

paragraph: This problem must not be **dismissed** out of hand. I didn't want to **dismiss** it out of hand. It is better to **dismiss** than to request.
english: to discharge
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي ألا تُتَجاهل هذه المشكلة بسرعة.

paragraph: The truck arrived at the **entrance** of the mine. Where is the **entrance** to the museum? This is not the **entrance**.
english: place of entering
arabicDesc: مثال: وصلت الشاحنة إلى مدخل المنجم.

other.meaning: action of entering, or going in

paragraph: We want to **modify** the regulations of our school. We usually **modify** our views in college. **Modify** exercises to fit your fitness level.
english: to change slightly

paragraph: This painting is a **representation** of a storm at sea. A **representation** is not the thing represented. If you are an ethnic writer, you have a burden of **representation**.
english: speaking or acting for others; also a picture of something
arabicDesc: مثال: تمثل هذه اللوحة عاصفة في البحر.

paragraph: This is not a time for **celebration**. My parents will be invited to the school **celebration**. I think that this calls for a **celebration**.
english: formal performance of a solemn rite
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا ليس وقت الإحتفال.

other.meaning: social gathering for entertainment and fun

paragraph: Nobody can put anything over on the **bureau** chief. I intend to put this matter to the **Bureau** tonight. The weather **bureau** says it will rain tonight.
english: an administrative unit of government

paragraph: I **lean** toward accepting the proposal. She ate only **lean** meat. I **leaned** against the tree.
english: to rest or rely upon for support
arabicDesc: مثال: أميل إلى قبول العرض.

paragraph: I've changed my daily **routine**. A change in **routine** can lead to new experiences. My wife is getting tired of the daily **routine**.
english: a course of action to be followed regularly
arabicDesc: مثال: غيرت نمط حياتي اليومي.

paragraph: I am a member of the French **Communist** Party. The post-**communist** government claims to be right-wing. She's no longer a supporter of the **communist** regime.
english: of, relating to, supporting, or advocating communism
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: شيوعية

other.meaning: An advocate of a society based on the common ownership of property (noun)

paragraph: I was **stunned** by the news. Stop, runner, or I'll **stun** you! Your house has a **stunning** view of the ocean.
english: to shock or surprise very much
arabicDesc: مثال: صدمتُ من الخبر

paragraph: The **airline** announced that the plane had landed. I've always wanted to work for an **airline**. They are a good **airline** to fly with.
english: a company that flies airplanes to transport people and goods
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خطوط جوية، خطوط طيران

paragraph: He feels this new law will **restrict** his freedom. The government is looking to **restrict** the gambling industry. This will **restrict** storage space.
english: to restrain within boundaries
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حدد

paragraph: We need to **communicate** with each other. I didn't catch what he was attempting to **communicate**. Computers can **communicate** with each other via the Internet.
english: to impart
arabicDesc: مثال: نحتاج ان نتواصل مع بعضنا البعض.

paragraph: They did everything they could to **foster** good relations. It's important to **foster** a culture of mutual respect. How did you end up in **foster** care?
english: to encourage something to develop; to care for a child who is not yours

paragraph: I will **sweep** out my room. The road dipped into a valley, then **swept** up over a hill. The servant **swept** the floor.
english: to clean (a surface) by means of a stroking motion of a broom or brush
arabicDesc: مثال: سأكنس غرفتي.

paragraph: He brought food to his guest and provided him **shelter**. The Indian extended family provides a sort of **shelter**. We took **shelter** from the rain under a tree.
english: somewhere one can find protection
arabicDesc: مثال: هوَ أحضر الطعام لضيفهُ وقدم لهُ المأوىَ.

paragraph: The king **governed** the country. The king has representative functions, but does not **govern**. They that **govern** the most make the least noise.
english: to exercise sovereign authority in
arabicDesc: مثال: حكم الملك البلد.

paragraph: Their furniture was chosen for **utility** rather than style. We have already been warned that **utility** rates will rise. Public **utility** charges will go up next April.
english: a service such as water or electricity; usefulness

paragraph: He got angry because his honor was at **stake**. She has a ten percent **stake** in this company. I don't have to tell you what's at **stake**.
english: the piece of timber to which a person condemned to death was affixed to be burned
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خازوق

other.meaning: timber to which a martyr was affixed to be burned
share or interest in a business

paragraph: Don't forget to put a **stamp** on your letter. I need to get a **stamp**. Whose image is on this **stamp**?
english: an act of stamping the foot, paw or hoof
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنسَ أن تضع طابعاً على رسالتك.

paragraph: He wants the most bang for his **buck**. How do you get the most bang for the **buck**? She is always out to make a **buck**.
english: an uncastrated sheep, a ram
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كبش

paragraph: Different **strokes** for different folks. The tests show that she didn't have a **stroke**. One egg a day may keep **stroke** at bay.
english: an act of hitting
arabicDesc: مثال: الناس اذواق

other.meaning: line or mark made on a surface by an implement for drawing, writing, etc.
loss of brain function arising when the blood supply to the brain is suddenly interrupted
To move one's hand or an object (such as a broom or brush) along (a surface) in one direction, touching it lightly (verb)

paragraph: She did the job with **ease**. He solved the problem with **ease**. We set out when the rain had **eased**.
english: the state of being easy; to make less painful
arabicDesc: مثال: قامت بالعمل بسهولة.

paragraph: The fire **pit** was in the middle of the clearing. Most people think that **pit** bulls are dangerous. He should smooth out the long jump **pit** a little.
english: a hole in the ground

paragraph: I enjoy cooking, but I don't like the cleaning up **afterwards**. We watched the movie and **afterwards** had dinner together. Have a bath! You'll feel fresh and relaxed **afterwards**.
english: at a later or succeeding time
arabicDesc: مثال: أستَمتِعُ الطَبْخَ لَكِنَّنِي لا أُحِبّ النِّظافة بَعدَهُ.

paragraph: **Alright**. Let's see what we can do. Look at you, you're crying. Come here. It's **alright**. Are you sure you'll be **alright** here by yourself?
english: all right; acceptable
arabicDesc: مثال: حسنا. لنرى ما بإمكاننا فعله.

paragraph: He spoke to me on **behalf** of the company. He put himself to much trouble on my **behalf**. We need people who work on **behalf** of all.
english: on behalf of: for someone or instead of them

paragraph: This book gives us a good idea of **economics**. Have you ever considered majoring in **economics** at college? Supply and demand is an important feature of **economics**.
english: the study of how money, goods and services are produced and used

paragraph: There is no denying that she is very **efficient**. My father wants an **efficient** assistant to help him. Can you guess which cooler is the most **efficient**?
english: making good, thorough, or careful use of resources

paragraph: This **electrical** device must have been damaged during delivery. The machine caught fire because of an **electrical** fault. Second-hand **electrical** equipment always shows signs of use.
english: using or relating to electricity

paragraph: The current French education system **essentially** produces lazy students. A dialogue is **essentially** a series of lines. It is **essentially** a question of time.
english: basically

paragraph: I'm on a **hockey** team. I don't like such sports as boxing and **hockey**. In **hockey** and soccer, goals are counted as points.
english: any of a family of sports in which hockey sticks are used to move a ball or puck into a goal
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لاعب في فريق هوكي.

paragraph: I'm so sure that **Islam** is a good religion. **Islam** is the right way to lead your life. He was the one who introduced me to **Islam**.
english: abrahamic religion
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا جد واثق أن الإسلام دين صالح.

paragraph: I always get **nervous** before I go on stage. I didn't know you were going to be **nervous**. I don't know if they were **nervous** or not.
english: of nerves
arabicDesc: مثال: أتوتر دائما قبل أن أخرج إلى المسرح.

paragraph: I have been **newly** appointed as a sales representative. The **newly** married couple went away to the mountains. Not far from us is a **newly** opened school.
english: recently

paragraph: Once inside, I realized how **odd** the situation was. Men judged those women to be **odd** or dangerous. I only work on days with **odd**-numbered dates.
english: differing from what is usual, ordinary or expected

paragraph: Nothing out of the **ordinary** happened on our trip. Citizen science allows **ordinary** citizens to contribute to science. I'm just an **ordinary** guy with nothing to lose.
english: having regular jurisdiction
arabicDesc: مثال: لا شيء خارق للعادة حدث أثناء سفرنا.

paragraph: I'm **rarely** invited to parties. She **rarely** sings, but tonight I think she will. I **rarely** translate something into languages other than English.
english: not occurring at a regular interval
arabicDesc: مثال: نادرًا ما أُدعى إلى الحفلات.

paragraph: Can you **illustrate** that using a concrete example? I will **illustrate** the way people use language. The teacher will **illustrate** how to do it.
english: to explain with examples; to draw pictures for a book

paragraph: Do you really think that **duck** face is cute? On the fifth day, the **duck** was still alive. Don't do the **duck**-face in your mirror self-shots!
english: aquatic bird of the family Anatidae
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بطة

paragraph: **Innovation** is the key to economic and industrial progress. The company places its main focus on **innovation**. Science is essential for **innovation** and progress.
english: the act of innovating

paragraph: We **derive** a lot of pleasure from books. You will **derive** great pleasure from this book. Some people **derive** pleasure from watching horror movies.
english: to obtain or receive (something) from something else

paragraph: It's difficult to **attribute** individual events to climate change. It isn't fair to **attribute** your failure to your parents. We **attribute** his success more to hard work than to genius.
english: a characteristic or quality of a thing
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خصوصية

other.meaning: To ascribe (something) to a given cause, reason etc (verb)

paragraph: **Dean** really eats quite a lot, don't you think? The **dean** of my department wasn't much older than me. The **dean** shook hands with each of the graduating students.
english: the head of a college or faculty at a university

paragraph: You may rest **assured** that we shall do all we can. I am **assured** of your help. But I **assure** you, that is not my intention.
english: to make sure and secure
arabicDesc: مثال: كن مطمئنا و اعلم أننا سنقوم بكل ما بوسعنا.

paragraph: The dip was so hot, it burned my **tongue**. When love speaks, reason holds its **tongue**. English is not my mother **tongue**.
english: such an organ, as taken from animals and used for food (especially from cows)
arabicDesc: مثال: الصلصة كانت حارة جداً ، انها حرقت لساني.

paragraph: The Japanese attacked Pearl **Harbor** on December 7, 1941. The **harbor** was crowded with vessels of every description. The ship was waiting for us in the **harbor**.
english: any place of shelter
arabicDesc: مثال: هاجم اليابانيون ميناء بيرل في السابع من ديسيمبر عام واحد و أربعين.

paragraph: Get this **devil** away from me. The **Devil** made me do it. The **devil** inside me always wins.
english: evil creature
arabicDesc: مثال: أبعد هذا الشيطان عني.

paragraph: This is not protection. This is just **restriction**. You didn't mention that **restriction** when we were writing up the contract. France announced new **restrictions** to contain the virus.
english: the act of restricting, or the state of being restricted
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: اقتصار، قيد

paragraph: A caged **cricket** eats just as much as a free **cricket**. I used to play **cricket** in my school days. I bought a new **cricket** bat for the game.
english: a signalling device used by soldiers in hostile territory to identify themselves to a friendly in low visibility conditions
arabicDesc: مثال: جُدجُد محتجز يأكل نفس ما يأكله نظيره الحر.

paragraph: We saw so many bands at that **venue**. Where is the **venue** for the meeting? Do you remember that music **venue** that used to be there?
english: the place where an event happens

paragraph: I am excited at the **prospect** of seeing her. I'm excited at the **prospect** of doing that. The **prospect** of spending a whole day with him excited me.
english: the region which the eye overlooks at one time
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: احتمال، أمل، إمكانية

paragraph: I want to be a **physician** in the future. The **physician** gave me the address of the hospital. The **physician** advised me to consume only steamed dishes.
english: medical doctor
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أكون طبيباً في المستقبل.

paragraph: My husband isn't quite the **provider** he should be. My new primary care **provider** is a great doctor! I need to find a new primary care **provider**.
english: a company that supplies a service

paragraph: The **rumor** spread throughout the country. There is a **rumor** that the radicals are plotting against the government. He didn't believe the **rumor**.
english: statement or claim from no known reliable source
arabicDesc: مثال: انتشرت الشائعة على مدار الدولة.

paragraph: He decided to **specialize** in physics at college. What did you **specialize** in at university? She will **specialize** in American history.
english: to focus on one area of work or study

paragraph: We didn't get home till the **wee** small hours. I remember when you were just a **wee** little baby. Teach your son to **wee** standing up.
english: very small (informal, Scottish)

paragraph: It really gets on my **nerves**. I don't have the **nerve** to do that again. He had the **nerve** to ask me for help.
english: a bundle of neurons with their connective tissue sheaths, blood vessels and lymphatics
arabicDesc: مثال: إن ذلك يغيظني حقاً.

paragraph: His best friend **ratted** him out to the authorities. He's successfully caught the big **rat** in the kitchen. I want to get away from the **rat** race.
english: a medium-sized rodent belonging to the genus Rattus
arabicDesc: مثال: بلّغ السلطاتِ عنه أفضلُ أصدقائه.

paragraph: Please **consume** within one to two days of opening. Anger is fueling a fire that threatens to **consume** me. Did the situation force you to **consume** all of this?
english: to use up or eat

paragraph: It's difficult to **assess** if the strategy will work. How do you **assess** the situation today? **Assess** people, not based on their appearance, but on their behavior.
english: to determine, estimate or judge the value of

paragraph: His **fate** is already decided. It feels like **fate** has other plans for us. It was not his **fate** to live until then.
english: the presumed cause, force, principle, or divine will that predetermines events
arabicDesc: مثال: إن مصيره محسوم.

paragraph: Mr Brown was acting in the capacity of **ambassador**. The English **ambassador** demanded to meet with the President directly. It was I who spoke with the Polish **ambassador**.
english: representative
arabicDesc: مثال: كان السيد براوين يعمل بصفة سفير.

paragraph: According to science, humans **evolved** from monkeys. He really needs to **evolve** as a person. Only those who are ready to change can **evolve** further.
english: to develop slowly
arabicDesc: مثال: وفقا للعلم ، تطور الإنسان من القرد.

paragraph: How did he get a truck to **flip** over? You see, I often made **flip**-books in class. You just don't like to **flip** all the time.
english: to throw so as to turn over

paragraph: I refuse to **consent** to that plan. His father **consented** to my plan against his will. My silence is not to be read as **consent**.
english: to express willingness
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أرفض الموافقة على تلك الخطة.

paragraph: Turn off the television. I can't **concentrate**. I can't **concentrate** while you're here. She **concentrated** on one thing.
english: bring to, or direct toward, a common center
arabicDesc: مثال: أطفأ التلفاز. لا يمكنني التركيز.

other.meaning: A substance that is in a condensed form (noun)

paragraph: Listen to me, I **beg** of you. You shouldn't have made me **beg**. I'm not going to **beg** you to do that.
english: to request the help of someone, often in the form of money
arabicDesc: مثال: أترجّاك أن تسمتع إليّ.

other.meaning: to plead with someone for help

paragraph: The stories in this book are **scary**. I don't like **scary** movies!!! This is a **scary** situation.
english: causing fear or anxiety
arabicDesc: مثال: قصص هذا الكتاب مرعبة.

paragraph: My brother **skips** school often. I never **skip** the theme song to this show. In order to lose weight some people **skip** meals.
english: to not do something; to jump lightly
arabicDesc: مثال: غالبا ما يغيب أخي عن المدرسة.
